Full contract index read. AONF is misnamed Agent Operad rather than Active Obstruction; GBQNF is misnamed Gauge Break rather than Generalized Boundary-Quotient; MUR is expanded as Multi-Unitary without that claim in the transport contract. Claimed associativity, consensus and atomic host parity do not follow from those linked specifications. Production/computed/gated metadata also exceeds two verification-absent contracts.

Full Hodge contract read. Under a finite nilpotent complex and declared positive-definite rational inner products, the orthogonal exact/harmonic/coexact split and uniqueness of summands are meaningful linear algebra. It correctly requires gauge choice for unique potentials, treats harmonic residue as a successful component rather than automatic obstruction, and says this directory executes no decomposition. It does not by itself classify semantic failures or rate-limit a swarm.

Full boundary-quotient repair contract read. Exactness, closure and quotient residuals are meaningful after a cochain complex, defect adapter and repair action are admitted. Semantic repair equivalence additionally needs that adapter/action to be sound; arbitrary state changes do not acquire faithful cochains merely by naming them. Replica convergence is explicitly disclaimed. Upstream proof references and executable metadata are not new checked evidence here.

Full representation transport contract read. The declared comparison square, target verification and conditional loss logging are useful obligations. Equality, natural isomorphism and a bounded defect are distinct laws; loss logging does not make a projection invertible. No concrete categories, functors or target checker are implemented here, and the selected schema check flags the undeclared family value coda. No unitary representation or multi-host atomic synchronization theorem is supplied.

Full active-obstruction contract read. It requires recorded activity, declared repair/extension families, exhaustion and explicit tie selection, separating proposal from execution. Its two-arm menu is conditional on those definitions and upstream admissions, not a new universal classification of agent actions. Its name does not supply an operad, and cited upstream Lean theorems were not rebuilt.

claims.statement: The Hodge contract states a meaningful conditional finite linear-algebra decomposition and correctly separates unique summands from gauge-dependent potentials and harmonic residue from a declared-law obstruction.

The index and learning route preserve useful negative evidence: historical executor/law limits, unresolved live transport failure, retired compatibility boundaries, and the distinction between detectors and antimorphisms. These qualify proposals rather than supply model-efficacy evidence.

Boundary-quotient repair, declared transport squares and active-obstruction menus can contribute explicit workflow preconditions after their carriers, maps, witnesses and adapters are supplied. The YAML does not implement those obligations or establish independent authorization.

findings.statement: The normal-form index assigns the wrong meanings to AONF, GBQNF and MUR, then claims operadic associativity, deterministic consensus and host parity from those links. The actual contracts concern active obstruction, boundary-quotient repair and representation transport; two explicitly have verification absent.
findings.recommended_action: Correct names and adapters and separate proposed mechanisms from checked implementations.

findings.statement: WasOperads.lean provides no composition function or operad-law theorem. Its tree constructor has no child colour/arity condition, and its receipt authority theorem applies only to one factory. The unrestricted receipt structure and syntax cannot establish all the invariants promised in the file header or broader curriculum.
findings.recommended_action: Scope the kernel claims to its actual definitional facts; add well-formedness, substitution and law proofs before treating it as an operad verifier. No fresh elaboration is claimed.

findings.statement: Both purported operadic laboratory notebooks contain only the same constant-True preflight. They provide no mathematical experiment, prediction gate or negative test despite verified/production lesson labels and storyboard promises of falsifiers.
findings.recommended_action: Exclude these scaffolds from workflow/testing counts and replace their placeholders with a specified operation and a meaningful counterexample.

findings.statement: The swarm specification says colour matching eliminates hallucinated artifacts and its receipt proves every wing inspected all claims. Coarse labels and a dataclass cannot establish those facts. The literal frozen snippet accepts empty participants/hash and an explicit EXECUTE effect; its mutable verdict mapping can change after construction.
findings.recommended_action: Define separate semantic/artifact checks and authenticated receipt construction; keep structural compatibility and verification evidence distinct. This is a teaching snippet, not a production exploit.

findings.statement: The local MUR contract uses identity.family=coda, which is absent from its adjacent custom meta-schema enum. All four contracts pass the selected required-field and terminal-map checks.
findings.recommended_action: Choose an admitted family or intentionally revise the governing enum with its consumers; do not infer semantic conformance from shape alone.
